args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your website (www.dora-website.com) — thanks for sharing it. Here's my feedback: It's nice and to-the-point, and it's great that you included your email address so people know exactly how to reach you. My one suggestion is that it feels a bit sparse for a "personal" website — it only says whose site it is and gives an email. Adding a short intro about who you are, what you do, and your interests or hobbies (the way Eve shares hers) would make it feel much warmer and more memorable. Also, the site was slow to load for me — it timed out a couple of times before it came up, so it may be worth a speed check. Overall: good foundation, just needs more of *you* on the page!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) — here's my feedback: It loaded instantly and it's wonderfully clear — in one line I know it's your blog, and sharing that your favorite hobby is hiking gives it an immediate personal touch that makes it easy to connect with you. My only suggestion is that it's quite minimal: there's just the single line about hiking. If you turned that into actual blog posts — a few entries about your favorite trails, photos, or trips — and added a way to contact you, it would give readers a reason to stick around and come back. Overall: clean, fast and friendly, now just give it some content!
